title: Interactive SVG Charts & Sparklines Guidelines
keyTechniques: Use inline responsive <svg viewBox="0 0 500 200" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"> elements for auto-scaling
Use smooth bezier curve paths using <path d="M ... C ..." fill="url(#chartGradient)" stroke="#6366f1" stroke-width="3" />
Define SVG linearGradients in <defs> with top-to-bottom opacity falloffs for fill areas
Add interactive <circle r="5" class="chart-point"> elements with CSS hover transitions for data tooltips
avoid: Do not use fixed width and height attributes without viewBox
Do not use heavy external canvas chart libraries when native SVG lines/paths suffice
referenceExample:
<svg viewBox="0 0 400 150" class="w-full h-40">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="grad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#6366f1" stop-opacity="0.4" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#6366f1" stop-opacity="0.0" />
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <path d="M0,100 Q100,20 200,80 T400,30 L400,150 L0,150 Z" fill="url(#grad)" />
  <path d="M0,100 Q100,20 200,80 T400,30" fill="none" stroke="#6366f1" stroke-width="3" />
</svg>
